中心数据集标部分终止系统；非主要支撑子过程标单工序单元过程且严禁脱离父系统复用

assessment.provenance: Actual private Next/compiler and untouched-exporter bytes from base 1d0c9cd6b19539a1c9ff68babe239418c2c1d5ae and a declared dirty working-preview. Temporary technical admission inside an isolated clone served inspection only and supplies no editorial acceptance.
assessment.reconstruction: Exact rollback of 3 managed B25 MDX files (oldFileShas + boundedMdxTransform), 80 raw records, and 2 raw fields recovers the exact c5b90b0352abaeaf0eec6706685076c8825d8925 predecessor pin (68aed4ba...) before #145 -> #143 -> #139 -> #137 -> #135 -> older qualifiers, verifying all 94 transitions and 409 cross-generation consumers.
assessment.guards: Multi-round independent adversarial publication-engineering and security audit verified immutability of original B25 artifacts and 40 case files, backward-compatible table/destRoute handling in reader-data-applicability.mjs, strict exactKeys envelopes, 63-fact zero-survivor BigInt rational guard, f650600 fixture isolation, 12 inline display:block print-visible correction notices validated prior to DOM stripping, and compiled CSS zero-drift (be180e5d...), concluding unconditional PASS (0 BLOCKER, 0 MAJOR, 0 MINOR).
assessment.actual: Comparison of all 88 article projections identifies the exact changed articles and public artifacts across B25 monograph, both website companions, shared-source/locator projections, and catalog/research downloads. All 468 manifest payloads and 40 case downloads verified.
assessment.browser: Passed 60 responsive viewport/theme checks (6 routes × 5 widths 390–2560px × light/dark, zero horizontal paragraph/document overflow) plus no-JS @media print verification confirming all 12 inline display:block correction notices (6 on /print, 2 on Companion 1, 4 on Companion 2) remain visible in print.
assessment.limits: Clean production build (dirty:false), source PR/CI/merge, live EdgeOne byte/guard qualification and exact root submodule integration remain required after this scoped acceptance.
